name: The Shadowhound's damage follows its owner's ranged attack power and spell power
contract: The Houndmaster passive 802233 says the hound gains damage from the owner's spell power and attack power, and
patch 71834 made Witch Hunter hound damage use ranged attack power. Live raid and leveling logs fit a permanent
Shadowhound hit of 3 x level + 0.22 x ranged attack power + 0.39 x spell power (the spell power share is the
class's usual 1.75:1 spell power to attack power ratio). Its weapon minimum is 90% of that. A level-60 owner with
+20000 ranged attack power gives about 4150 and one with +10000 spell power about 3700. The old reconstruction
